name: morandi-cinematic-poster-zeejay
title_zh: 照片变电影海报，但只留你拍下的真实光影
tagline_zh: 不用星星、不用拼贴符号，只靠排版、留白和低饱和配色，让旅行或建筑照片直接拥有影院级片头质感，还带一句诗意的署名。
tagline_en: No stars, no collage icons—just typography, negative space, and muted tones to give travel or architecture shots.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied personal photograph into a source-faithful, typography-driven Morandi cinematic poster without stars or decorative collage symbols. Use film-poster title design, optional poetic byline and tagline, atmospheric metadata, optional fictional credits, intentional negative-space placement, perspective alignment, and selective subject occlusion. why_zh: 不是「生成一张海报」，是把搜集来的场面压成一种固定的电影静帧：低饱和、一层雾、像印在纸上。
why_en: It doesn't slap on a template—it aligns type with the photo's own perspective and occlusion, so text feels embedded, not pasted.
limit_zh: 风格锁死在莫兰迪电影静帧。要热闹大片、要品牌 VI、要多风格切换，这件会把你按回去。
limit_en: Single portrait or architecture/travel photo only; no illustration or compositing; face must be clear for occlusion; static poster only; you supply.
title_en: Turn your photo into a film poster using only its real light
